{{Quote|The Rkok clan foolishly unloaded a cargo of questionable merchandise on Jabba the Hutt, who was neither pleased nor forgiving.|Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole, mentioning the Rkok clan's decision that led to deadly consequences|<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rkok clan''' was a clan of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At one point prior to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], the Rkok clan unloaded a cargo of questionable merchandise, which they sold to Jabba.<ref name="SWE" /> An angry Jabba responded to the faulty merchandise by destroying the clan's [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] and feeding the surviving Jawas to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|79|JAW 9-12|Jawas}}</ref> a basin in which the sarlacc resided at the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]].<ref name="SWE" />

At the edge of the Great Pit of Carkoon, another Jawa clan, the [[Nkik clan]], found the remains of the Rkok clan's destroyed sandcrawler. No sign of any Rkok Jawas was found,<ref name="SWE" /> except for a few of the dead Jawas' torn [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] around the Great Pit of Carkoon's lip. [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] would proceed to document the incident when writing a report on Tatooine.<ref name="Illustrated" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kevin J. Anderson]] created the Rkok clan for ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', a reference book published in [[1995]].<ref name="Illustrated" />
